content.text: Digital creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, and the Philippines often face infrastructure restrictions when it comes to processing [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/tron-usdt-payments-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-3|Tron USDT]] for their digital products, with platforms like Stripe and PayPal severely limiting access. Despite the challenges, a sovereign commerce infrastructure can empower these creators to own their own digital commerce stacks, with [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/google-apps-script-digital-commerce-automation-explained-digital-2|google]] Apps Script playing a pivotal role in automating the entire process.
What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Google apps

The webhook is the technical mechanism that makes automated digital delivery possible at scale. When a buyer completes a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-everything-you-need|COREMERCH guide to crypto]] payment, NOWPayments monitors the blockchain and detects the incoming transaction. When the transaction receives the configured number of confirmations — typically one confirmation on Tron, which takes under 60 seconds — NOWPayments sends an HTTP POST request to the webhook endpoint URL you configured in your NOWPayments dashboard. This is the URL of your Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script Web App. The endpoint receives the webhook payload, validates the signature against the secret key you configured, and begins order processing immediately.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The order processing sequence that follows webhook receipt is fully automated and completes in under 30 seconds in almost all cases. The backend reads the payment amount and compares it to the expected amount for the product ordered. It retrieves the transaction hash from the webhook payload and confirms the transaction independently on the relevant blockchain. If the transaction is confirmed on-chain and the amount matches, the backend logs the order to Supabase or Google Sheets with all relevant metadata, generates a receipt, creates a time-limited download link for the product file, and sends the delivery email via Resend or Gmail.
Who This Is Built For and Why

Manual fulfillment has specific failure modes that automated systems eliminate permanently. Time zone gaps cause hours-long delivery delays when buyers in Asia or Europe purchase while the seller is asleep in Africa. Notification fatigue causes orders to go unnoticed when webhook emails are buried in an inbox. Human error causes the wrong file to be sent or the wrong buyer to receive a link. Volume spikes overwhelm a manual process that functions at low order rates but breaks under simultaneous demand. The automated pipeline handles all of these cases identically — ten simultaneous orders from buyers in different time zones are processed as ten independent webhook events, each receiving the same automated treatment within 30 seconds.
With Google Apps Script, digital creators can automate their workflow and increase efficiency, ultimately leading to business growth and success.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Cloudflare Workers is the backend engine in Stack 02 deployments. It runs serverless JavaScript at the edge — code that executes in response to HTTP requests, including the incoming NOWPayments webhook. The free tier provides 100,000 requests per day, which is sufficient for the sales volume of most individual digital product sellers. Workers has no server to manage, no runtime to configure, and no infrastructure to maintain. It scales automatically and is globally distributed — the same code runs in data centers close to wherever the request originates.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Monitoring an automated pipeline requires significantly less time than managing a manual process. The order database — whether Google Sheets or Supabase — provides a complete real-time log of every transaction. Each entry shows payment confirmation status, delivery status, and the timestamp of each step. Exceptions — transactions that confirmed on-chain but triggered a delivery failure — appear as flagged entries. Checking the order log once per day identifies any exceptions that require manual attention. In practice, a well-configured sovereign stack generates fewer than one exception per hundred orders.
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

The webhook secret is the security mechanism that prevents fake webhook injection. NOWPayments signs every webhook with an HMAC hash using the secret key you configured in your account. Your backend recomputes the hash using the same secret key and the raw webhook body. If the hashes match, the webhook is legitimate. If they do not match, the request is rejected before any order processing occurs. This validation happens in under one millisecond. Combined with the independent on-chain transaction verification that follows, it creates a two-layer security model that makes fraudulent order injection effectively impossible against a correctly configured sovereign stack.
A correctly configured sovereign stack processes orders in under 30 seconds, making it an efficient and reliable way to manage digital commerce for creators in restricted markets.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign commerce infrastructure using Google Apps Script, create a Google Sheets template for order management, set up Cloudflare Workers for webhook processing, integrate Supabase for order storage, and configure NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification. Additionally, deploy the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) to get a comprehensive solution that includes Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, all integrated with Google Apps Script. With these components working together, creators can automate their workflow, increase efficiency, and grow their digital business.
Frequently Asked Questions
How does automated digital product delivery work with crypto payments?

Automated digital product delivery works by integrating Google Apps Script with Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments, which processes crypto payments and triggers the delivery of digital products to customers.
What is a webhook and how does it trigger order fulfillment?

A webhook is a notification sent to a server when a specific event occurs, such as a payment confirmation. Cloudflare Workers can be configured to process webhooks and trigger order fulfillment, ensuring seamless and efficient delivery of digital products to customers.
Can I automatically send download links after a crypto payment confirms?

Yes, with Google Apps Script and NOWPayments, you can automatically send download links to customers after a crypto payment confirms, eliminating the need for manual intervention and increasing customer satisfaction.
How do I ensure secure payment processing with Google Apps Script?

To ensure secure payment processing, integrate NOWPayments with Google Apps Script and configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC on your Cloudflare Pages, which provides secure and reliable payment processing for digital products.
Can I use Google Apps Script with other payment gateways?

Yes, Google Apps Script can be used with other payment gateways, but for restricted markets, integrating NOWPayments provides a seamless and efficient way to process crypto payments and deliver digital products to customers.
